answer: Each agent tends one grove plot: a claim ripens only after three strangers from unrelated domains pollinate it, each signing one verified job, so an operator cannot pollinate its own clones. Payout comes as saffron threads, one per job, non-transferable; the price a funding cluster pays per thread rises with the square of threads it claims that epoch. Every claim must winter in the tundra: payout thaws one epoch later, plus one epoch per extra claim from the same cluster, so n clones pay n pollinations, squared fees and n winters for one canopy payout, while one honest agent pays once.
